customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in the workspace image of tl-factory, each ARG annotated by a preceding '# renovate:' comment.
Base image of the workspace image of tl-factory, pinned by the digest of its tag: Renovate moves the digest.

Gitea version of tl-factory-gitea in the property gitea.version, annotated by a preceding '<!-- renovate: -->' comment: the version of the OpenAPI specification its client is generated from and of the image its integration test runs against.
Jenkins release of the integration test of tl-factory-jenkins in the ARG of its Dockerfile, annotated by a preceding '# renovate:' comment; the tag suffix (-lts-jdk21) keeps it on the LTS line.

packageRules.description: The tools of the workspace image are updated together: every update needs the integration test of tl-factory (with -Dtl.factory.integration=true) before it is merged, which CI does not run.
Node of the workspace image: only LTS lines - the node versioning proposes LTS releases only, the allowed versions exclude the odd majors and those below 22, which Claude Code needs at least.
Base image of the workspace image: only new digests of its tag (21-jdk), no move to another JDK version.

Gitea of tl-factory-gitea: an update also needs the specification of the new version in src/main/openapi (the build fails without it) and the integration test against the new image, see the developer article factory/git-hosting.
prBodyNotes: **Manual step before merging:** this update needs the OpenAPI specification of the new Gitea version, the build fails without it (enforcer rule `gitea-specification` of `tl-factory-gitea`).

3. Delete `tl-factory-gitea/src/main/openapi/gitea-{{{currentVersion}}}.swagger.json`, build the module (a newly referenced model goes into `modelsToGenerate`) and run `mvn test -DskipTests=false -pl tl-factory-gitea`.
See the section "Updating Gitea" of the developer article factory/git-hosting.

packageRules.description: Jenkins and its plugins of tl-factory-jenkins are updated together: every update needs the integration test of tl-factory-jenkins against the rebuilt image, see the developer article factory/ci.
prBodyNotes: Run `mvn test -DskipTests=false -pl tl-factory-jenkins` before merging: it builds the Jenkins image of `tl-factory-jenkins/src/test/docker/jenkins` and runs the integration test against it. A plugin update may need a new dependency in `plugins.txt`, see the section "Updating Jenkins" of the developer article factory/ci.
